text:
maria: CI red on render tests after serializer change — snapshot mismatch for prompt-render-v2. Sorry for noise, can someone kick a rerun? Details below.
ci-bot: TEST_FAILURE summary: 12/172 tests failed in job render-tests (flake detection: off). Failing test: tests/render/test_prompt_render_v2.py::test_snapshot
chris: Which diff? paste the failing snapshot
maria: ```diff
- 'Hello, world!'
+ 'Hello, world! '
```
maria: Looks like extra trailing space in tokenization output.
arjun: Can you rerun with `TEST=tests/render/test_prompt_render_v2.py::test_snapshot -k 'prompt-v2' -q` and set `TOKENIZER_DEBUG=1`? Also try with `KV_CACHE=0`.
maria: running now: `./scripts/ci/rerun_test.sh tests/render/test_prompt_render_v2.py::test_snapshot --env TOKENIZER_DEBUG=1` I'll report back.
chris: FTR I saw similar in #eng-runtime earlier when we enabled the whitespace-preserving tokenizer. Try `TOKENIZER=legacy` to see if it's regressed by tokenizer change.
hannah: if it's whitespace-only, maybe we add a normalization step in the snapshot comparator instead of changing serializer.
maria: rerun finished — still red. output same trailing space. :grimacing: 
ci-bot: RERUN finished for thread 1912345678 — status: failed (1 rerun). Full logs: https://ci.example.com/1912345678
arjun: can you run `git bisect` locally between main@{1 week} and HEAD? I can do a bisect on CI if you prefer.
maria: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — it touched tokenizer normalizer. I don't have cycles to bisect right now, can someone take it?
chris: I'll take it. Starting bisect with `git bisect start HEAD main~7 && git bisect run ./scripts/ci/run_snapshot_test.sh tests/render/test_prompt_render_v2.py` — will report.
chris: Found bad commit: abc1234 — "tokenizer: preserve trailing whitespace for split-tokens". Reproducer: checkout abc1234 -> run tests -> fail.
maria: thanks so much @chris :tada: That matches PR 432 related change. I think quick fix is to normalize trailing whitespace in serializer or add a fallback to legacy tokenizer.
hannah: I'll open a follow-up PR to add a snapshot normalizer to the comparator (strip trailing spaces for now) — will link here when ready.
chris: Also filing an issue to add a flag to run snapshots under both tokenizer modes in CI.
maria: great, let's keep the test pinned until fix rolls. Thanks all. :wave:
